The component is the s3presign runner at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`.

It refreshes presigned S3 attachment URLs before they expire after five days. It runs every twelve hours and also executes once immediately on startup. It is wired into server startup through `startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go` at line 129.

The runner only processes S3 storage type attachments. External storage references may contain arbitrary URLs that do not require presigned URL refresh.

External storage handles user-provided static URLs. S3 handles externally stored content via presigned URLs.

The s3presign runner keeps externally stored links from going stale. It refreshes presigned URLs before their five-day expiry. It triggers when fewer than four days remain. It checks every twelve hours. The component is wired into server startup at server/server.go:129.

The exact wiring site is server/server.go:161, where the s3presign runner is instantiated inside startBackgroundRunners.

**s3presign runner** — **every 12 hours** — **server/server.go:129**

The `s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` refreshes S3 presigned URLs stored in attachment `Reference` fields before they expire (presigned URLs last 5 days; attachments are skipped if still valid for the next 4 days). The interval is defined at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27` (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`).

At startup, `Server.Start()` calls `startBackgroundRunners()` at `server/server.go:129`, which runs the presign check once immediately (`RunOnce` at `server/server.go:163`) and then starts the 12-hour loop in a goroutine (`Run` at `server/server.go:169`).
